title: Freeze documentation and operation contracts
exit_gate: Every researched item maps to a requirement; every relevant contract field is captured or explicitly blocked.

title: Audit licenses and reproducible dependency closure
exit_gate: No unapproved code or runtime dependency required for the selected unrestricted build.

title: Create reference environments and behavioral fixtures
exit_gate: Reference credentials/data are synthetic and authorized; unavailable commercial reference behavior stays marked unverified.

title: Run foundation feasibility spike
deliverables: OSS SuperTokens reuse comparison if required
exit_gate: Critical tenant/link/session/embedded-SDK examples pass without insecure password-grant shortcuts or two credential authorities.

title: Implement canonical tenancy and identity mapping
exit_gate: Parallel same-email and shared-user tests preserve distinct app/tenant contexts.

title: Establish security envelope and build/deployment skeleton
exit_gate: Unauthenticated private API access fails; secrets never enter browser bundles; production rejects ephemeral persistence.

title: Establish adapters and configuration contract
exit_gate: All auth calls resolve explicit app/tenant context; unknown versions fail explicitly.

title: Build session authority and transports
exit_gate: Concurrent refresh/response-loss/replay/rotation tests pass without blanket grace periods.

title: Build password and email verification flows
exit_gate: One-time actions consume atomically; disabled/banned/wrong-tenant users cannot obtain sessions.

title: Build message outbox and delivery adapters
exit_gate: Delivery outage/retry tests do not leak secrets or duplicate authentication effects.

title: Build passwordless and invitation flows
exit_gate: Resend, replay, brute-force and mail-preview tests pass.

title: Complete social provider adapters
exit_gate: Each baseline provider has a passing permitted live test or a clearly blocked live qualification; mocks alone do not certify provider interoperability.

title: Implement transactional linking and ID mapping
exit_gate: Same-email and verified-domain shortcuts cannot take over another identity.

title: Implement app roles and tenant-scoped assignments
exit_gate: Negative resource-ownership and stale-privilege tests pass.

title: Implement MFA factors and recovery
exit_gate: Factors cannot enroll/remove/recover without the configured evidence and replay controls.

title: Implement WebAuthn/passkey lifecycle
exit_gate: Wrong origin/RP/challenge and replay attempts fail; physical-platform qualification is separately recorded.

title: Implement enterprise discovery and SAML
exit_gate: Signed assertion issuer/audience/recipient/replay and administrator ownership tests pass.

title: Implement OAuth/OIDC provider and unified login
exit_gate: No ROPC shortcut; issuer/client/redirect/token audience conformance and multi-app logout tests pass.

title: Implement machine-to-machine lifecycle
exit_gate: User tokens cannot silently become machine credentials; wrong-audience credentials fail.

title: Implement MCP authorization
exit_gate: Wrong-resource tokens and authorized-user/unauthorized-tool calls fail; unsupported protocol revision is explicit.

title: Build local risk signal acquisition
exit_gate: Missing data is unknown rather than a fabricated safe verdict.

title: Build risk policies, actions and evaluation
deliverables: quality test corpus and false-positive report
exit_gate: All actions enforce policy, quality targets are declared before measurement, and failures remain visible.

title: Build local and optional CAPTCHA adapters
exit_gate: No vendor key is required for the local default; challenge replay or flow substitution fails.

title: Build user lifecycle and self-service profile
exit_gate: Protected-field mass assignment and profile-gate bypass tests fail safely.

title: Build authentication UI and extension contracts
exit_gate: Every error/loading/recovery state has a tested UI; server enforcement survives bypassing UI.

title: Build admin/customer console
exit_gate: Tenant administrators cannot obtain platform scope or view another tenant’s credentials/configuration.

title: Close fourteen-plugin parity
exit_gate: Both server and frontend plugin halves pass lifecycle and customization tests.

title: Complete Node/Python/Go backend SDK profiles
exit_gate: Each baseline SDK profile builds and passes contracts; unsupported upstream features are not invented as prior parity.

title: Complete web, React and mobile frontend profiles
exit_gate: Browser/native lifecycle tests and selected OS/SDK build evidence exist.

title: Complete framework/platform integration samples
exit_gate: Each example is runnable and tested; paid hosting is never the only deployable option.

title: Build migration/import/reconciliation/rollback
exit_gate: No unexplained data delta; nonportable sessions/passkeys are declared, not silently lost.

title: Qualify clustering, performance and dependency failure
exit_gate: Chosen measured latency/capacity targets hold; dependency outages follow declared fail-open/closed policy.

title: Qualify backup, restore, key lifecycle and upgrades
exit_gate: An independent clean deployment restores correctly without resurrecting revoked credentials or relying on lost encryption keys.

title: Qualify sovereignty and no-fee execution
exit_gate: Full local feature profile runs without entitlement servers, vendor dashboard login or trial expiry.

title: Close all operation/SDK compatibility contracts
exit_gate: No missing business behavior or undocumented claimed compatibility; no success stubs.

title: Independent security assessment and release decision
exit_gate: All required rows verified with evidence; critical/high exploitable issues resolved; quality/operations limits disclosed.
